Description

Amazon seeks a business intelligence engineer to be a key partner for the Amazon IX Advertising Sales business, with a range of products offerings for advertisers. We’re looking for a top technical and analytical mind capable of extracting value out of our large and disparate data sets. You will influence the direction of the business by leveraging our data to deliver insights that drive decisions, evolution of our products and the way they fit into Amazon's ecosystem. Additionally, you’ll help streamline and simplify the metric reporting needs for our operating cadences such as daily, weekly and monthly business reviews. Our ideal candidate is a self-starter, comfortable working through ambiguity, conceptualizing and leading complex initiatives from end to end, and has an entrepreneurial spirit. In addition to working with many stakeholders internally and externally, this role requires working through ambiguity, demonstrating good judgment under pressure and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Key job responsibilities

Own the design, development, and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to drive key business decisions - Own the forecasting model for IX countries and enhance the existing model to align with sales calls while minimizing forecasting errors. - Make recommendations for new metrics, techniques, and strategies to improve team performance and measurement in the future - Define the data elements and data structure that our team should leverage to enable analytical and reporting capabilities for our business development team - Design and influence operational best practices for reporting and analytics to enable the team to scale - Prepare and deliver business reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and roadblocks - Work with engineering and the data warehouse to enable the appropriate capture and storage of key data points - Enable effective decision making by retrieving and aggregating data from multiple sources and compiling it into a digestible and actionable format - Participate in strategic & tactical planning discussions

A day in the life

Your day will be a dynamic blend of data exploration, strategic problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll dive deep into complex data landscapes, crafting visualizations and models that reveal hidden patterns and opportunities for Amazon's advertising platforms.

About The Team

The Ads Sales Finance team is a global group of 30+ Data and BI engineers who partner with finance managers, sales, and product stakeholders to build the forecasting, reporting, and analytics backbone for Amazon Ads. Our mission is to deliver scalable datamarts, models, and dashboards that standardize reporting across regions, minimize forecasting error, and provide leadership with the insights needed to make confident, data-driven decisions. As part of the team, you will collaborate across functions to solve complex problems such as handling massive data volumes, evolving product hierarchies, and aligning multiple upstream and downstream systems—directly impacting how Ads revenue is tracked, forecasted, and managed at scale.

Basic Qualifications

• 4+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
• 1+ years of SQL, ETL or Oracle experience
• 4+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
• 1+ years of performing statistical analysis experience
• 1+ years of developing automated reporting experience
• Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
• Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
• Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
• Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
• Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

Company:

The Boeing Company has an exciting opportunity for a Business Intelligence Analyst (Mid-Level or Lead) to join the Engineering & Technology Innovation (E&TI) Business Intelligence organization. This position is available in El Segundo, or other locations listed.

As a member of the E&TI Business Intelligence team, you will transform complex business and operational data into decision-ready insights that improve visibility, enable strategic planning, and support execution across the organization.

You will partner with leaders, subject matter experts, and cross-functional teams to define reporting needs, develop scalable analytics solutions, and deliver dashboards, metrics, and narratives that drive action. Success in this role requires strong analytical judgment, curiosity, and the ability to align stakeholders around a common view of performance.

This position requires experience working with large datasets, business systems, and visualization tools to identify trends, measure performance, and recommend improvements. Clear written and verbal communication, data storytelling, and the ability to present complex information to leadership and diverse stakeholders are essential.

• Collect, manipulate, visualize, and analyze data from multiple business systems to support operational and strategic decision-making
• Design, build, automate, and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and recurring performance reports

• Analyze business problems and perform root-cause analysis to understand solution space and implement identified opportunities

• Translate business questions into data requirements, reporting logic, and actionable insights
• Support data governance, standard metric definitions, and consistent reporting practices across the organization
• Present analysis and recommendations to functional leaders and executive stakeholders in a clear, concise manner
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams to implement reporting improvements and fulfill business intelligence priorities

This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at one of the listed location options.

• Bachelor's Degree or higher
• 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Finance, or related field
• Experience working with large data sets required (e.g. advanced Excel, Power Pivot, Tableau and/or Microsoft Power BI)
• Knowledge in Database (preferred: Postgres, SQLite)and experience in writing SQL

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):
• Level 4: 9 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience
• Experience with Boeing business systems and enterprise data sources
• Experience and openness to modern AI concepts and tools to improve efficiency
• Experience scripting and writing code to automate solutions
• Strong organizational, analytical, and effective communication skills
• Experience interfacing with senior and executive leadership
• Ability to synthesize ambiguous problems, derive insights from data, and communicate findings simply and effectively

Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)is seeking a highly strategic, data-driven Business Intelligence Program Manager to join our Executive Program Management team. This role is responsible for shaping and driving the data strategy behind organization-wide efficiency, cost optimization, and operational excellence initiatives across Oracle.

As a Business Intelligence Program Manager, you will leverage large-scale data ecosystems to influence executive decision-making, identify transformational business opportunities, and drive programs that deliver measurable impact across Oracle. You will partner closely with senior executives and cross-functional leaders to define key business metrics, establish operational benchmarks, and develop scalable analytical frameworks that support long-term strategic objectives.

We are a team of technical program managers who drive a broad portfolio of cost efficiency programs, tools, and initiatives with significant executive visibility. We focus on surfacing meaningful metrics, automating reporting and insights wherever possible, and using data to guide business decisions. We continuously explore Oracle-wide datasets to uncover new opportunities for optimization, operational improvements, and cost savings. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence Oracle’s strategic direction by owning critical portions of the data ecosystem that inform executive-level decisions.

Responsibilities

• Define and lead business intelligence strategies that support Oracle-wide operational efficiency, cost optimization, and executive decision-making.
• Own highly complex analytics initiatives spanning multiple organizations, systems, and datasets, delivering actionable insights that drive measurable business outcomes.
• Identify emerging trends, risks, inefficiencies, and opportunities through deep analysis of Oracle-wide data, proactively recommending strategic actions to senior leadership.
• Architect and oversee the development of scalable metrics, reporting frameworks, and robust SQL-based data pipelines that serve as foundational sources of truth across the organization.
• Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert to senior executives, including VP and SVP leadership, on business performance, operational effectiveness, and strategic planning.
• Drive cross-functional alignment among engineering, finance, operations, and business leaders to establish shared metrics, priorities, and accountability models.
• Lead the definition of executive-level operational reviews, business health metrics, and performance scorecards.
• Develop new analytical approaches, methodologies, and frameworks that improve Oracle’s ability to measure performance and identify optimization opportunities at scale.
• Champion process improvement initiatives and operational excellence programs that increase organizational efficiency, effectiveness, and productivity.
• Influence long-range planning, quarterly business priorities, and strategic investments through data-driven recommendations and executive-level reporting.
• Mentor and provide guidance to other program managers and analysts, helping elevate analytical rigor and business intelligence capabilities across the organization.
• Drive efforts that improve the efficiency and effectiveness of Oracle leadership and executive management teams.

Minimum Qualifications:

• 10+ years of relevant experience in business intelligence, technical program management, analytics, operations, or related disciplines.
• Deep technical expertise in data analytics, large-scale data pipelines, SQL, business intelligence platforms, reporting architectures, and data visualization technologies.
• BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
• Demonstrated success leading highly visible, cross-organizational initiatives that influence business strategy and executive decision-making.
• Proven ability to independently represent the organization at the VP and SVP level and effectively communicate complex technical and business concepts to executive audiences.
• Strong track record of identifying organization-wide challenges and driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups to achieve measurable outcomes.
• Experience operating within large-scale, globally distributed technology organizations.
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including executive presentation and storytelling capabilities.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking skills with the ability to connect detailed data analysis to broader business objectives.
• Demonstrated leadership, influence, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills in highly ambiguous and rapidly evolving environments.
• Ability to think broadly, act strategically, and drive execution across organizational boundaries.
• Experience mentoring others and establishing best practices in analytics, reporting, and program management.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with cloud infrastructure, hyperscale platforms, or large-scale distributed systems.
• Familiarity with OCI products, cloud operations, capacity planning, cost management, or infrastructure economics.
• Experience driving executive business reviews, operational excellence programs, or enterprise-wide efficiency initiatives.

Description

Amazon seeks an experienced Business Intelligence Engineer (BIE) to join the Deny Party Screening (DPS) team. Our mission is to prevent denied parties from transacting with Amazon businesses, including AWS, customers, vendors, sellers, subsidiaries etc. We build automatic mechanisms to detect and prevent prohibited transactions with the denied parties using a diverse set of algorithms and machine learning techniques. We screen over half a billion events every day, integrate with Tier 1 systems and deal with unique scaling challenges. We are still Day 1 and have an exciting road map to build Machine Learning (ML) and Analytics powered detection and resolution systems to help scale Amazon for years to come.

In this role you'll own everything from ad-hoc reporting to long term analytical and statistical projects that will affect the effectiveness of the DPS team. You'll work with multiple Amazon Businesses and Functions, work with multiple data sources and a wide range of data technologies (e.g. Redshift, S3, Tableau, Quicksight etc.), stay abreast of emerging technologies, investigate and implement where appropriate.

Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

• Interface with business customers to gather requirements, drive reporting or analytic projects to help solve complex challenges.
• Design, implement, and support datasets that provide structured data for reporting and analysis.
• Develop reports and dashboards across various business teams to drive adoption and increase visibility into key measures of business performance.
• Analyze billions of rows of data to find the root causes behind variances and drive business insights.
• Investigate and implement new big data technologies to provide automatic resolutions to address business needs.

A day in the life

The successful candidate will demonstrate good business acumen, experience in developing reports and conducting analysis, strong technical skills and communication skills, an ability to work effectively cross functional teams, and an ability to work in an ever-changing environment.

About The Team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

• 5+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
• Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
• Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
• Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
• Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
• Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

About the position

Boeing Global Services (BGS) is looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to join our team in Seattle, WA. In this role, you will lead the design and delivery of complex Business Intelligence (BI) information models, dashboards, metrics and reports that meet business objectives. Additionally, you will be responsible for evaluating current technologies for best fit and apply proven methodologies and best practices. Lastly, you will combine strong SQL/programming skills, data modeling expertise and domain knowledge to produce efficient, scalable BI solutions that improve business productivity and outcomes.

Responsibilities
• Act as a technical and strategic leader across cross-functional teams
• Lead the end-to-end design and development of BI solutions: data models, ETL/ELT pipelines, semantic layers, cubes, metrics and visualizations
• Translate business requirements into robust BI architectures, metrics definitions and dashboards that enable insight and action
• Assess existing technology stack and recommend tools, platforms and patterns (cloud on premises) that best meet performance, scale, security and cost objectives
• Author and enforce best practices for data modeling, data quality, metadata management, naming conventions and version control
• Write, optimize and review complex SQL and other data transformation code to ensure efficient, scalable pipelines
• Build reusable, documented semantic layers / dataset definitions to ensure consistency of business metrics across dashboards and reports
• Mentor and coach BI developers, analysts and data engineers; conduct design reviews and code reviews
• Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, data engineers, data scientists and IT for delivery, deployment and operational support
• Establish monitoring, alerting and troubleshooting processes for BI performance and data quality
• Drive continuous improvement: prototype new capabilities, proof-of-concepts and adoption of new BI/analytics trends (embedded analytics, self-service BI, data observability)

Requirements
• 5+ years of experience developing reports and insights utilizing reporting/data analytical/business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Spotfire, Power BI and Maximo
• 5+ years of experience with SQL/Teradata SQL, R, Python or Toad
• 3+ years of experience with data pipeline tools and Extract Transform Load (ETL) services
• 1+ years of experience with large-scale data processing, distributed computing, and cloud platforms
• 3+ years of experience with development and integration of programs, plans, strategies, processes, and KPIs to track progress to and enable attainment of business goals

Nice-to-haves
• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Science, Business Analytics or related field
• Experience implementing self-service BI programs and training business users
• Certifications such as Certified Business Intelligence Professional, vendor-specific BI certifications, or cloud data platform certifications
• Excellent communication skills and proven ability to work with non-technical stakeholders to define requirements and present insights

Benefits
• health insurance
• flexible spending accounts
• health savings accounts
• retirement savings plans
• life and disability insurance programs
• paid and unpaid time away from work
